ValidationRule.description: Avoid edit approval process data fields when status differ from Draft or Proposal
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: (ISCHANGED(DMT_Operation__c) || ISCHANGED( DMT_Nominal__c ) || ISCHANGED( DMT_RAROEC_RORC_Proposal__c) || ISCHANGED( DMT_Franchise_L12M__c ) || ISCHANGED( DMT_Client_Use__c ) || ISCHANGED( DMT_ApproverGlobalBanker__c ) || ISCHANGED( DMT_Booking_Unit_Risk_Analyst__c) || ISCHANGED( DMT_Approver__c )) && ((ISPICKVAL(Status__c, "Ready to close") || ISPICKVAL(Status__c, "Closed")|| ISPICKVAL(Status__c, "Approval")) && !DMT_Allow_Approval_Edit__c )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Approval process data change is not allowed for the current state.
